sections.bodyMarkdown:
### Finishing a project stage

Hold a short review, thank people for specific contributions and identify any remaining loose ends. When celebration and handover are both clear, the team can more genuinely put the stage behind them.

articleMarkdown:
# Four of Wands: Make room for completion and belonging

Card: Four of Wands  
Card marking: IV  
Minor Arcana · Wands  
Keywords: Stability · Celebration · Belonging

## At a glance

Upright: There is somewhere to settle, feel at ease and celebrate together

Reversed: The scene may be lively without feeling secure or welcoming to everyone

The garlanded structure in the Four of Wands does not enclose the people. Four poles mark out a place to gather while leaving the front open, bringing celebration and welcome into the same picture.

## The space beneath the garland stays open

Four tall, leafy wands stand in the ground against a bright yellow background. A garland of flowers, fruit and foliage stretches across the top, with red bows tied to the outer poles. There is no door or fence across the middle, so we can look through the temporary structure to the scene behind.

Two people raise bouquets. One wears mainly pale and blue fabric; the other is draped in red. Behind them are walls, red-roofed towers, a bridge to the right and a small distant group. The atmosphere is clearly festive, but the event is not named and there is not enough evidence to establish the relationship between the two central figures.

## Waite retains joy in both orientations

Waite directly links the Four of Wands to repose, refuge, harmony and a domestic harvest celebration. Notably, he says the main meaning remains largely unchanged when reversed, continuing with prosperity, happiness and embellishment.

From that background, this article develops a contemporary question: what helps people genuinely settle in? It uses the reversal to explore a gap between celebration and belonging. That is an explicitly modern exercise, not a claim that Waite described the reversed card as family discord.

## Reading it upright

Upright, the card can invite you to acknowledge a completed stage and give the achievement a visible place. Celebration need not be elaborate. It might be finishing work on time, eating with collaborators or arranging a space that is finally ready to use. Pausing to feel completion helps distinguish what is already done from what remains in progress.

Belonging also has practical conditions: who is invited, who prepares everything, and can people participate comfortably? A stable setting offers more than a lively atmosphere. People know the arrangements, the division of work and where they can rest. Maintaining those conditions together can turn a brief gathering into dependable support.

## Reading it reversed

Here, the reversal compares feelings with arrangements. A celebration may be ready while someone is still too busy to join. A home may look comfortable while everyday rules remain undiscussed. An achievement may deserve recognition while you keep feeling it is insufficient. Each situation needs closer, specific attention.

Ask what is missing: rest, a say in how things happen, acknowledgment or a way of celebrating that suits you better. A lack of excitement does not erase what you accomplished. Nor does preserving a festive appearance require everyone to display the same emotion.

## In everyday life

### Finishing a project stage

Hold a short review, thank people for specific contributions and identify any remaining loose ends. When celebration and handover are both clear, the team can more genuinely put the stage behind them.

### Moving into a shared home

Alongside decorating, discuss quiet hours, visitors and everyday responsibilities. Giving everyone room to state their needs contributes more to feeling at home than appearance alone.

### Preparing a gathering

Keep the scale manageable for everyone. Ask how people want to take part and make it easy for those who would rather not stay long to leave. Welcome should not become an obligation.

## A short exercise

Choose a small stage you recently completed. Write down what was actually finished, who took part and what kind of celebration would feel comfortable. Mark it in one simple way, then list the unfinished parts separately.

## Common misreadings

Even when the Four of Wands is used to discuss a wedding or setting up a home, the image does not require marriage or guarantee a stable relationship. Its learning focus can remain on shared space, a sense of completion and the real conditions for belonging.

## Artwork and English sources

- [A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part III §2, Four of Wands (1911-labelled English transcription)](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktwa04.htm)

sourceRecord.title: 权杖四 让完成与相聚有一个位置
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 有了可以安心停留、一起庆祝的地方
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 表面很热闹，心里未必安稳或有归属感
sourceRecord.hook: 权杖四的花环架没有把人关在里面。四根杖围出一处可以相聚的空间，前方依然敞开，让庆祝与欢迎同时进入画面。
imageReading: 明黄色背景前，四根长杖并列立在地面，顶端长着叶子。花果与绿叶组成的花环横跨上方，外侧两根杖系着红色带结。中央没有门板，也没有栅栏阻断视线，我们可以透过这座临时搭起的架子看向后方。
两个人举起花束，一人衣料以浅色和蓝色为主，另一人披着红色衣料。后面有城墙、红顶塔楼、右侧的桥与远处一小群人。图像确实呈现节庆氛围，但没有标注活动名称，也没有足够依据确定中央两人的关系。
tradition: Waite 直接把权杖四联系到休憩、避风港、和谐与家庭式的收获庆祝。值得留意的是，他认为这张牌逆位时主旨仍基本不变，并继续列出繁荣、喜悦和美化环境等词。
本篇从这层历史背景发展“怎样让人真正安顿下来”的现代主题。逆位则用于检视庆祝和归属感之间的落差，这是明确标出的当代练习方法，不是声称 Waite 把逆位写成家庭失和。
uprightMeaning: 正位可以提醒你承认一个阶段已经完成，给成果一个被看见的位置。庆祝不需要宏大，也可以是按时收工、与合作的人吃顿饭，或整理好一个终于可以使用的空间。停下来感受完成，能帮助你区分“已经做到”和“仍在路上”。
归属感也包含具体条件：谁受到邀请，谁负责准备，每个人是否能自在地参与？一个稳定的环境不只提供热闹，还让人知道规则、分工与休息的地方。共同维持这些条件，才能让短暂相聚成为可靠的支持。
reversedMeaning: 本篇把逆位当作一次感受与安排的核对。活动已经准备好，却有人一直忙到无法加入；住处看似舒适，实际的生活规则却没有谈清；成果值得高兴，自己却总觉得还不够。这些情况都值得具体了解。
先问缺少的是休息、参与权、认可，还是一个更适合自己的庆祝方式。不要因为暂时没有兴奋感，就否定已经完成的事；也不要为维持热闹外表，要求每个人表现同样的情绪。

situations.title: 项目告一段落
situations.text: 安排一次简短复盘，具体感谢每个人做过的事，并确认哪些收尾仍需要处理。庆祝和交接都清楚，团队才更容易真的放下这一阶段。

situations.title: 搬进新的共同住处
situations.text: 除了布置房间，也谈谈安静时段、访客和日常分工。让每个人都能提出需要，比单看空间是否漂亮，更接近可以安心生活的基础。

situations.title: 准备一次聚会
situations.text: 把规模控制在大家可以承受的范围内。提前询问参与方式，并给不想久留的人留出方便离开的选择，欢迎才不会变成压力。

sourceRecord.practice: 选一个最近完成的小阶段，写下它具体完成了什么、谁参与其中、怎样庆祝才让自己舒服。做一件简单的纪念动作，再把尚未结束的部分单独列出。
sourceRecord.commonMisread: 即使把权杖四用于讨论婚礼或成家，原图也没有限定必须结婚，也不能保证某段关系稳定。它的学习重点可以放在共同空间、完成感与真实的归属条件上。
sourceRecord.sourceClaim: Waite 的休憩、避风港、收获庆祝与和谐；其逆位主旨基本不变。归属条件和庆祝落差为原创现代解读。
sourceRecord.imageReadingTitle: 花环下面留着敞开的空间
sourceRecord.traditionTitle: Waite笔下正逆位延续的喜悦
sourceRecord.readingApproach: 图像可见事实、Waite 历史解释与原创现代反思分别标示；正逆位是学习与自我反思提示，不用来确认未来、健康或他人隐秘行为。
sourceRecord.reverseMethod: 当代反思式读法，依据主题的受阻、失衡、过度或需要重新安排展开；不是对 Waite 旧逆位词条逐项翻译。
